hash_semantics.ARTIFACT_MANIFEST_SHA256: SHA-256 over an artifact-manifest file; a subtype of file-content SHA-256
hash_semantics.CANONICAL_JSON_SHA256: SHA-256 over a declared canonical JSON serialization; not used unless a field says so
hash_semantics.FILE_CONTENT_SHA256: SHA-256 over the exact file bytes; the only hash kind used for source binding here
hash_semantics.GIT_BLOB_SHA1: git object id; not used for file-content binding
